Since 1946, we've worked to challenge the status quo, break down barriers, and build a more equitable future. With bold commitments- including becoming net-zero by 2040 across all mortgages and loans-we are championing financial resilience, climate action, and belonging for our members and communities. As the largest private sector Living Wage Employer in Canada and home to a team of 2,300 passionate employees, Vancity offers competitive rewards and benefits, diverse career pathways, and the opportunity to be part of something bigger. The Opportunity: We're looking for an intern to join our credit risk team for a 4-month opportunity. The credit risk team supports Vancity by: • Evaluating loan applications: Reviewing mortgages, personal loans, and business financing requests to assess borrowers' financial strength and the level of risk involved. • Monitoring the health of the loan portfolio: Analyzes trends in repayments, delinquencies, and economic conditions to identify emerging risks early. • Setting and maintaining responsible lending standards: Develops credit policies and risk frameworks that ensure lending is prudent, fair, and aligned with regulatory requirements. • Providing risk insights to leadership: Prepares reporting and analysis that support strategic decisions on growth, capital management, and long-term financial stability. This role will report into credit risk strategy and systems manager while also supporting the entire credit risk leadership team. A typical day would involve: • Supporting data validation and migration work for commercial portfolios, gaining hands-on experience with how lending data is prepared for analysis, reporting, and risk assessment. • Conducting market and industry research on credit risk trends and emerging risks, and helping summarize findings into short reports outlining potential impacts. • Assisting with building and organizing a centralized database of reference materials to support the development of a Credit Center of Excellence. • Helping analyze data and preparing reports and dashboards to support management reporting and insights on specific areas of interest. • Using AI and analytical tools to assist in reviewing and improving internal policies and documents, focusing on clarity, consistency, and readability. • Collaborating with teams across the organization to identify opportunities to improve processes, procedures, and documentation, gaining exposure to operational efficiency initiatives. You'll learn: • How commercial lending and credit risk data is collected, validated, and prepared for analysis and reporting in a real-world financial environment. • Practical experience working with data during system and model transitions, and understanding why data quality matters. • How market and industry research is conducted and translated into clear insights for decision-makers. • Hands-on exposure to data analysis, reporting, and dashboard preparation for management reporting. • How internal policies and procedures are reviewed, improved, and maintained, including responsible use of AI tools. How teams collaborate across an organization to improve processes and operational efficiency. • What You'll Earn: This role offers a pay range of $27.85/hr. Job Requirements You have: • Current enrollment in an undergraduate program within an applicable field and eligible for co-op/internship opportunities (i.e. business, finance, economics, data analytics, information systems) • An interest in data analysis, research, and understanding how data supports business and risk decisions. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. • Comfort working with data in Excel or similar tools; experience with analytics or visualization tools is an asset but not required. • Curious, motivated, and eager to learn in a professional environment. • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly summarize findings. • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members.
